headline: Record $2.5B holiday quarter: Coach +25%, North America +17%; Tapestry raises FY26 EPS outlook to $6.40-6.45.
guidance_note: FY26 revenue raised to >$7.75B (from ~$7.3B); non-GAAP EPS $6.40-6.45 from $5.45-5.60.
key_messages: Revenue +14% reported, +18% pro forma; Coach +25% to $2.14B, Kate Spade -14%.
North America +17%, Europe +22%, Greater China +34% (cc); Coach North America +27% per one report.
Reported 3.7M+ new customers globally, with strong Gen Z engagement.
Gross margin 75.5% (+110 bps) despite ~190 bps tariff/duty hit (~140 bps Coach, ~520 bps Kate Spade).

consumer.big_ticket: Holiday handbag demand very strong, led by Coach.
consumer.pricing: Tariffs cut ~190 bps from gross margin, offset by operational gains and less discounting.

macro_read: Holiday 2025 spending on accessible luxury was strong in the US, with young shoppers buying full-price Coach bags despite tariff-driven costs.
notes: Growth excludes Stuart Weitzman (sold) and is in constant currency. It is revenue growth, not a like-for-like comp.
Stock hit a record intraday; reported moves range from +3.7% intraday to >+10% close (single source), so null.
EPS consensus $2.22 (FactSet/Benzinga); another source cited $2.19. Revenue consensus $2.32B is LSEG.
GAAP EPS $2.68 vs non-GAAP $2.69. Pro forma growth excludes Stuart Weitzman.
